scope: methods-only consolidation and scale audit; no empirical source access; EOG-WF 3/31/3 unchanged
method: time-DAG per-node antichain of required restoration-site masks; prune supersets; world possible = minimal union, robust = minimal pairwise OR product; cut family = incremental minimal transversal of repair family; no edge-world mixing

resource_limit.meaning: cap on live minimal labels at any state/aggregation/transversal insertion; exceed => fail closed, no frontier or certificate; not a runtime or memory guarantee

small.generator: Python random.Random; draw edges by lexical ordered node pairs with 1<=dt<=2, abs(site diff)<=4*dt, rng.random()<0.3; sites1..8 restorable; source/target protected; original graph edges fixed; explicit waits only
small.oracle: for each world and all 256 enabled-site masks use direct topological reachability, independently derive exact inclusion-minimal true restoration masks and false deletion masks by immediate predecessor criterion; verify local and aggregate possible/robust repair/cut families; zero mismatch

large.construction: three world-specific mandatory gateways 0,1,2; shared alternatives 3..n-1. Each world has paths S(t0)->its gate(t1)->one alternative(t2)->T(t3). All sites disabled initially. Compare analytical local, possible, robust repairs and cuts; possible repairs gate+alternative, robust all 3 gates+one alternative. Possible cuts all three gates OR all alternatives; robust cuts any singleton gate OR all alternatives.
large.comparison: number of masks 2^n versus returned frontier counts and peak antichain size, not runtime speedup against unrun full enumeration

adversarial.construction: one world, two independent restorable choices per layer, complete forward edges between adjacent layers, source/target protected. Expected repair family 2^k, cut family k paired cuts. For k=8,10 verify complete exact families; k=12 must hit 2048 live-label cap and return no partial frontier. Report cap as algorithmic limitation.

success: all small oracle comparisons, analytical large cases, and fail-closed adversarial behavior pass; report all failures and no claim of generic polynomial scalability
stop: No production API change, no new predictive endpoint or dataset fishing; no ecological effect claims. Consolidate v1-v5; retain draft stack.
